name: progress
need: Show how far a known or unknown amount of work has come

--ds-progress-height.description: linear progress: the track's thickness at md, before the size step

--ds-progress-bar.description: linear progress: the bar, over any tone

--ds-progress-gap.description: linear progress: the gap between the bar and the remaining track

--ds-progress-track.description: linear progress: the remaining track, the stop dot at its end

--ds-progress-stop.description: linear progress: the remaining track, the stop dot at its end

physical..ds-progress__track: background: gradient direction: the bar fills left to right with its clip
